data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $92m for Syndicate 2003 was experienced during the year driven from various lines of business. The most significant contributors were London Wholesale Property ($96m) and International discontinued casualty ($17m) accounts due to unfavourable claims experience offset by the favourable movement on Marine ($20m) etc.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant adverse development in London Wholesale Property prior years
Adverse development on international discontinued casualty accounts
Favourable movement on Marine prior years offsetting some deterioration

named_events.event_name: California Wildfires; Typhoon Jebi; Typhoon Trami; Hurricanes Michael and Florence (collective)
named_events.loss_description: Collectively these represented gross losses to the Syndicate of $453m. Net of all reinsurance and related reinstatement premiums, the total losses on these events was $218m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior-accident-years deterioration of $92m in 2018 (strengthening of reserves). The deterioration was driven primarily by adverse prior-year development in London Wholesale Property (~$96m) and international discontinued casualty (~$17m), partially offset by a favourable movement on Marine (~$20m). Current-year catastrophe events (California wildfires, Typhoon Jebi, Typhoon Trami, Hurricanes Michael and Florence) generated significant gross losses but were substantially mitigated by reinsurance, netting $218m.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement ($92m) is taken from the Movement in Prior Year's Provision narrative (note 5) which states a $92m prior-accident-years deterioration; the technical provisions note indicates a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) from Syndicate 1209 of $532.922m added to gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2018 which may distort claims development comparisons. Currency and amounts are reported in the native reporting currency (USD) and in millions. The claims development triangle is present but includes an 'X and prior' aggregate column and an RITC entry which may distort diagonal-based PYD calculations.
